Linux KVM Flaw CVE-2026-99312 Lets Guest VMs Access Host Memory on AMD Hosts
item.description: A flaw in KVM, the hypervisor built into the Linux kernel, let researchers read about 127 GB of a cloud server's memory from inside a virtual machine of their own on DigitalOcean. On a shared server, that memory can include other customers' virtual machines. The flaw, tracked as CVE-2026-99312, affects only hosts with AMD processors and nested virtualization enabled. Fixed kernels shipped

item.title: VMware vCenter zero-day exploited for months before patch (CVE-2026-123890)
item.description: A suspected China-nexus espionage group tracked as Armory Castle (formerly UNC5221) has been exploiting a VMware vCenter zero-day since at least early September, more than two months before Broadcom released a fix, Google Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) revealed. The vulnerability (CVE-2026-123890) carries a CVSS score of 9.8 and allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to obtain an administrator session on vCenter Server, which organizations use to manage their VMware servers and virtual machines. Broadcom fixed it … More → The post VMware vCenter zero-day exploited for months before patch
